i18n.zhTitle: 10个AI代理介绍实例！日本企业和地方政府的成就和成功的共同点
i18n.zhSummary: 当管理层被问到“日本同行业的其他公司在多大程度上引入了人工智能代理？”时，许多推广经理无法提供具体的公司名称和数字。人工智能代理是一种能够自主执行从收集信息到执行任务以实现给定目标的所有操作的人工智能。在日本，从全公司范围扩大努力的大型企业到专注于具体业务的中型企业，以及正在进行示范的地方政府，公开数值结果的案例也越来越多。
i18n.enTitle: 10 AI agent introduction examples! Common points in the achievements and successes of Japanese companies and local governments
i18n.enSummary: When management is asked, ``To what extent have other companies in the same industry in Japan introduced AI agents?'', many promotion managers are unable to provide specific company names and figures. An AI agent is an AI that autonomously performs everything from collecting information to executing tasks toward a given goal. In Japan as well, there are an increasing number of cases in which numerical results are made public, from large companies that expand their efforts across the company to medium-sized companies that focus on specific operations, and local governments that are conducting demonstrations.
